lines.text: But in what nature?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: In such a one as, you consenting to’t,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Would bark your honour from that trunk you bear,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And leave you naked.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Let me know the point.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O, I do fear thee, Claudio, and I quake,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Lest thou a feverous life shouldst entertain,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And six or seven winters more respect

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Than a perpetual honour. Dar’st thou die?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: The sense of death is most in apprehension;

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And the poor beetle that we tread upon

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: In corporal sufferance finds a pang as great

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: As when a giant dies.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Why give you me this shame?

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Think you I can a resolution fetch

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: From flowery tenderness? If I must die,

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: I will encounter darkness as a bride

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: And hug it in mine arms.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: There spake my brother! There my father’s grave

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Did utter forth a voice. Yes, thou must die.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Thou art too noble to conserve a life

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: In base appliances. This outward-sainted deputy,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Whose settled visage and deliberate word

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Nips youth i’ th’ head, and follies doth enew

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: As falcon doth the fowl, is yet a devil.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: His filth within being cast, he would appear

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: A pond as deep as hell.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: The precise Angelo?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O, ’tis the cunning livery of hell

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: The damned’st body to invest and cover

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: In precise guards! Dost thou think, Claudio,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: If I would yield him my virginity

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Thou mightst be freed?

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: O heavens, it cannot be.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Yes, he would give it thee, from this rank offence,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: So to offend him still. This night’s the time

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: That I should do what I abhor to name,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Or else thou diest tomorrow.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Thou shalt not do’t.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O, were it but my life,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I’d throw it down for your deliverance

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: As frankly as a pin.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Thanks, dear Isabel.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Be ready, Claudio, for your death tomorrow.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Yes. Has he affections in him

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: That thus can make him bite the law by th’ nose

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: When he would force it? Sure it is no sin;

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Or of the deadly seven it is the least.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Which is the least?

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: If it were damnable, he being so wise,

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Why would he for the momentary trick

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Be perdurably fined? O Isabel!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: What says my brother?

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Death is a fearful thing.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And shamed life a hateful.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Ay, but to die, and go we know not where;

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: To lie in cold obstruction, and to rot;

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: This sensible warm motion to become

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: A kneaded clod; and the delighted spirit

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: To bathe in fiery floods, or to reside

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: In thrilling regions of thick-ribbed ice;

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: To be imprisoned in the viewless winds

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: And blown with restless violence round about

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: The pendent world; or to be worse than worst

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Of those that lawless and incertain thought

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Imagine howling—’tis too horrible.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: The weariest and most loathed worldly life

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: That age, ache, penury, and imprisonment

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Can lay on nature is a paradise

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: To what we fear of death.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Alas, alas!

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Sweet sister, let me live.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: What sin you do to save a brother’s life,

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Nature dispenses with the deed so far

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: That it becomes a virtue.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O, you beast!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O faithless coward! O dishonest wretch!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Wilt thou be made a man out of my vice?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Is’t not a kind of incest to take life

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: From thine own sister’s shame? What should I think?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Heaven shield my mother played my father fair,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: For such a warped slip of wilderness

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Ne’er issued from his blood. Take my defiance,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Die, perish! Might but my bending down

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Reprieve thee from thy fate, it should proceed.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I’ll pray a thousand prayers for thy death,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: No word to save thee.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Nay, hear me, Isabel.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O fie, fie, fie!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Thy sin’s not accidental, but a trade.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Mercy to thee would prove itself a bawd.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: ’Tis best that thou diest quickly.
[_Going._]

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: O, hear me, Isabella.
Enter Duke as a Friar.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Vouchsafe a word, young sister, but one word.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: What is your will?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Might you dispense with your leisure, I would by and by have some

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: speech with you. The satisfaction I would require is likewise your own

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: benefit.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I have no superfluous leisure, my stay must be stolen out of other

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: affairs, but I will attend you a while.
[_To Claudio aside_.]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Son, I have overheard what hath passed between

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: you and your sister. Angelo had never the purpose to corrupt her; only

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: he hath made an assay of her virtue, to practise his judgement with the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: disposition of natures. She, having the truth of honour in her, hath

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: made him that gracious denial which he is most glad to receive. I am

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: confessor to Angelo, and I know this to be true; therefore prepare

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: yourself to death. Do not satisfy your resolution with hopes that are

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: fallible. Tomorrow you must die; go to your knees and make ready.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: Let me ask my sister pardon. I am so out of love with life that I will

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: sue to be rid of it.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Hold you there. Farewell.
[_Exit Claudio._]
Enter Provost.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Provost, a word with you.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: What’s your will, father?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That, now you are come, you will be gone. Leave me a while with the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: maid; my mind promises with my habit no loss shall touch her by my

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: company.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: In good time.
[_Exit Provost._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The hand that hath made you fair hath made you good. The goodness that

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: is cheap in beauty makes beauty brief in goodness; but grace, being the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: soul of your complexion, shall keep the body of it ever fair. The

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: assault that Angelo hath made to you, fortune hath conveyed to my

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: understanding; and, but that frailty hath examples for his falling, I

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: should wonder at Angelo. How will you do to content this substitute,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: and to save your brother?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I am now going to resolve him. I had rather my brother die by the law

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: than my son should be unlawfully born. But, O, how much is the good

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Duke deceived in Angelo! If ever he return, and I can speak to him, I

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: will open my lips in vain, or discover his government.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That shall not be much amiss. Yet, as the matter now stands, he will

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: avoid your accusation: he made trial of you only. Therefore fasten your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ear on my advisings, to the love I have in doing good, a remedy

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: presents itself. I do make myself believe that you may most

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: uprighteously do a poor wronged lady a merited benefit; redeem your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: brother from the angry law; do no stain to your own gracious person;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: and much please the absent Duke, if peradventure he shall ever return

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: to have hearing of this business.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Let me hear you speak farther. I have spirit to do anything that

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: appears not foul in the truth of my spirit.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Virtue is bold, and goodness never fearful. Have you not heard speak of

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Mariana, the sister of Frederick, the great soldier who miscarried at

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: sea?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I have heard of the lady, and good words went with her name.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: She should this Angelo have married, was affianced to her oath, and the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: nuptial appointed. Between which time of the contract and limit of the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: solemnity, her brother Frederick was wrecked at sea, having in that

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: perished vessel the dowry of his sister. But mark how heavily this

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: befell to the poor gentlewoman. There she lost a noble and renowned

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: brother, in his love toward her ever most kind and natural; with him,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: the portion and sinew of her fortune, her marriage dowry; with both,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: her combinate husband, this well-seeming Angelo.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Can this be so? Did Angelo so leave her?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Left her in her tears, and dried not one of them with his comfort,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: swallowed his vows whole, pretending in her discoveries of dishonour;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: in few, bestowed her on her own lamentation, which she yet wears for

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: his sake; and he, a marble to her tears, is washed with them, but

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: relents not.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: What a merit were it in death to take this poor maid from the world!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: What corruption in this life, that it will let this man live! But how

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: out of this can she avail?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It is a rupture that you may easily heal, and the cure of it not only

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: saves your brother, but keeps you from dishonour in doing it.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Show me how, good father.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: This forenamed maid hath yet in her the continuance of her first

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: affection. His unjust unkindness, that in all reason should have

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: quenched her love, hath, like an impediment in the current, made it

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: more violent and unruly. Go you to Angelo; answer his requiring with a

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: plausible obedience; agree with his demands to the point. Only refer

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: yourself to this advantage: first, that your stay with him may not be

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: long; that the time may have all shadow and silence in it; and the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: place answer to convenience. This being granted in course, and now

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: follows all. We shall advise this wronged maid to stead up your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: appointment, go in your place. If the encounter acknowledge itself

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: hereafter, it may compel him to her recompense; and here, by this, is

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: your brother saved, your honour untainted, the poor Mariana advantaged,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: and the corrupt deputy scaled. The maid will I frame and make fit for

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: his attempt. If you think well to carry this as you may, the doubleness

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: of the benefit defends the deceit from reproof. What think you of it?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: The image of it gives me content already, and I trust it will grow to a

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: most prosperous perfection.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It lies much in your holding up. Haste you speedily to Angelo; if for

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: this night he entreat you to his bed, give him promise of satisfaction.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I will presently to Saint Luke’s; there at the moated grange resides

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: this dejected Mariana. At that place call upon me; and dispatch with

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Angelo, that it may be quickly.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I thank you for this comfort. Fare you well, good father.
[_Exit Isabella._]
Enter Elbow, Pompey and Officers.

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: Nay, if there be no remedy for it, but that you will needs buy and sell

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: men and women like beasts, we shall have all the world drink brown and

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: white bastard.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O heavens, what stuff is here?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: ’Twas never merry world since, of two usuries, the merriest was put

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: down, and the worser allowed by order of law a furred gown to keep him

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: warm; and furred with fox on lambskins too, to signify that craft,

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: being richer than innocency, stands for the facing.

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: Come your way, sir.—Bless you, good father friar.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And you, good brother father. What offence hath this man made you, sir?

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: Marry, sir, he hath offended the law; and, sir, we take him to be a

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: thief too, sir; for we have found upon him, sir, a strange picklock,

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: which we have sent to the deputy.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Fie, sirrah, a bawd, a wicked bawd;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The evil that thou causest to be done,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That is thy means to live. Do thou but think

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: What ’tis to cram a maw or clothe a back

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: From such a filthy vice. Say to thyself,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: From their abominable and beastly touches

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I drink, I eat, array myself, and live.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Canst thou believe thy living is a life,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: So stinkingly depending? Go mend, go mend.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Indeed, it does stink in some sort, sir. But yet, sir, I would prove—

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Nay, if the devil have given thee proofs for sin,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Thou wilt prove his. Take him to prison, officer.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Correction and instruction must both work

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Ere this rude beast will profit.

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: He must before the deputy, sir; he has given him warning. The deputy

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: cannot abide a whoremaster. If he be a whoremonger and comes before

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: him, he were as good go a mile on his errand.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That we were all, as some would seem to be,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Free from our faults, as faults from seeming, free!

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: His neck will come to your waist—a cord, sir.
Enter Lucio.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: I spy comfort, I cry bail! Here’s a gentleman, and a friend of mine.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: How now, noble Pompey? What, at the wheels of Caesar? Art thou led in

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: triumph? What, is there none of Pygmalion’s images, newly made woman,

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: to be had now, for putting the hand in the pocket and extracting it

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: clutched? What reply, ha? What say’st thou to this tune, matter, and

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: method? Is’t not drowned i’ th’ last rain, ha? What say’st thou, trot?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Is the world as it was, man? Which is the way? Is it sad and few words?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Or how? The trick of it?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Still thus, and thus; still worse!

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: How doth my dear morsel, thy mistress? Procures she still, ha?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Troth, sir, she hath eaten up all her beef, and she is herself in the

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: tub.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Why, ’tis good. It is the right of it. It must be so. Ever your fresh

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: whore and your powdered bawd; an unshunned consequence; it must be so.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Art going to prison, Pompey?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Yes, faith, sir.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Why, ’tis not amiss, Pompey. Farewell. Go, say I sent thee thither. For

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: debt, Pompey? Or how?

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: For being a bawd, for being a bawd.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Well, then, imprison him. If imprisonment be the due of a bawd, why,

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: ’tis his right. Bawd is he doubtless, and of antiquity, too. Bawd born.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Farewell, good Pompey. Commend me to the prison, Pompey. You will turn

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: good husband now, Pompey; you will keep the house.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: I hope, sir, your good worship will be my bail.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: No, indeed, will I not, Pompey; it is not the wear. I will pray,

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Pompey, to increase your bondage. If you take it not patiently, why,

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: your mettle is the more. Adieu, trusty Pompey.—Bless you, friar.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And you.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Does Bridget paint still, Pompey, ha?

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: Come your ways, sir, come.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: You will not bail me then, sir?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Then, Pompey, nor now.—What news abroad, friar? What news?

lines.speaker: ELBOW
lines.text: Come your ways, sir, come.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Go to kennel, Pompey, go.
[_Exeunt Elbow, Pompey and Officers._]

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: What news, friar, of the Duke?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I know none. Can you tell me of any?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Some say he is with the Emperor of Russia; other some, he is in Rome.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: But where is he, think you?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I know not where, but wheresoever, I wish him well.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: It was a mad fantastical trick of him to steal from the state and usurp

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: the beggary he was never born to. Lord Angelo dukes it well in his

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: absence. He puts transgression to’t.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He does well in’t.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: A little more lenity to lechery would do no harm in him. Something too

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: crabbed that way, friar.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It is too general a vice, and severity must cure it.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Yes, in good sooth, the vice is of a great kindred; it is well allied;

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: but it is impossible to extirp it quite, friar, till eating and

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: drinking be put down. They say this Angelo was not made by man and

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: woman after this downright way of creation. Is it true, think you?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: How should he be made, then?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Some report a sea-maid spawned him; some, that he was begot between two

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: stockfishes. But it is certain that when he makes water, his urine is

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: congealed ice; that I know to be true. And he is a motion ungenerative;

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: that’s infallible.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You are pleasant, sir, and speak apace.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Why, what a ruthless thing is this in him, for the rebellion of a

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: codpiece to take away the life of a man! Would the Duke that is absent

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: have done this? Ere he would have hanged a man for the getting a

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: hundred bastards, he would have paid for the nursing a thousand. He had

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: some feeling of the sport; he knew the service, and that instructed him

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: to mercy.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I never heard the absent Duke much detected for women; he was not

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: inclined that way.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: O, sir, you are deceived.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ’Tis not possible.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Who, not the Duke? Yes, your beggar of fifty; and his use was to put a

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: ducat in her clack-dish. The Duke had crotchets in him. He would be

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: drunk too, that let me inform you.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You do him wrong, surely.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Sir, I was an inward of his. A shy fellow was the Duke; and I believe I

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: know the cause of his withdrawing.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: What, I prithee, might be the cause?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: No, pardon. ’Tis a secret must be locked within the teeth and the lips.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: But this I can let you understand: the greater file of the subject held

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: the Duke to be wise.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Wise? Why, no question but he was.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: A very superficial, ignorant, unweighing fellow.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Either this is envy in you, folly, or mistaking. The very stream of his

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: life, and the business he hath helmed, must upon a warranted need give

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: him a better proclamation. Let him be but testimonied in his own

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: bringings-forth, and he shall appear to the envious a scholar, a

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: statesman, and a soldier. Therefore you speak unskilfully. Or, if your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: knowledge be more, it is much darkened in your malice.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Sir, I know him, and I love him.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Love talks with better knowledge, and knowledge with dearer love.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Come, sir, I know what I know.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I can hardly believe that, since you know not what you speak. But, if

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ever the Duke return, as our prayers are he may, let me desire you to

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: make your answer before him. If it be honest you have spoke, you have

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: courage to maintain it. I am bound to call upon you, and I pray you

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: your name?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Sir, my name is Lucio, well known to the Duke.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He shall know you better, sir, if I may live to report you.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: I fear you not.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O, you hope the Duke will return no more; or you imagine me too

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: unhurtful an opposite. But indeed, I can do you little harm. You’ll

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: forswear this again.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: I’ll be hanged first! Thou art deceived in me, friar. But no more of

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: this. Canst thou tell if Claudio die tomorrow or no?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Why should he die, sir?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Why? For filling a bottle with a tun-dish. I would the Duke we talk of

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: were returned again. This ungenitured agent will unpeople the province

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: with continency. Sparrows must not build in his house-eaves because

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: they are lecherous. The Duke yet would have dark deeds darkly answered.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: He would never bring them to light. Would he were returned! Marry, this

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Claudio is condemned for untrussing. Farewell, good friar, I prithee

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: pray for me. The Duke, I say to thee again, would eat mutton on

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Fridays. He’s now past it; yet, and, I say to thee, he would mouth with

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: a beggar though she smelt brown bread and garlic. Say that I said so.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Farewell.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: No might nor greatness in mortality

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Can censure ’scape. Back-wounding calumny

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The whitest virtue strikes. What king so strong

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Can tie the gall up in the slanderous tongue?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But who comes here?
Enter Escalus, Provost and Officers with Mistress Overdone, a Bawd.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Go, away with her to prison.

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: Good my lord, be good to me. Your honour is accounted a merciful man,

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: good my lord.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Double and treble admonition, and still forfeit in the same kind? This

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: would make mercy swear and play the tyrant.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: A bawd of eleven years’ continuance, may it please your honour.

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: My lord, this is one Lucio’s information against me. Mistress Kate

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: Keepdown was with child by him in the Duke’s time; he promised her

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: marriage. His child is a year and a quarter old come Philip and Jacob.

lines.speaker: BAWD
lines.text: I have kept it myself; and see how he goes about to abuse me.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: That fellow is a fellow of much license. Let him be called before us.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Away with her to prison. Go to, no more words.
[_Exeunt Officers with Bawd._]

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Provost, my brother Angelo will not be altered; Claudio must die

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: tomorrow. Let him be furnished with divines, and have all charitable

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: preparation. If my brother wrought by my pity, it should not be so with

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: him.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: So please you, this friar hath been with him, and advised him for th’

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: entertainment of death.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Good even, good father.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Bliss and goodness on you!

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Of whence are you?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Not of this country, though my chance is now

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To use it for my time. I am a brother

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Of gracious order, late come from the See

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: In special business from his Holiness.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: What news abroad i’ th’ world?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: None, but that there is so great a fever on goodness that the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: dissolution of it must cure it. Novelty is only in request, and as it

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: is as dangerous to be aged in any kind of course as it is virtuous to

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: be constant in any undertaking. There is scarce truth enough alive to

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: make societies secure; but security enough to make fellowships

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: accursed. Much upon this riddle runs the wisdom of the world. This news

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: is old enough, yet it is every day’s news. I pray you, sir, of what

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: disposition was the Duke?

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: One that, above all other strifes, contended especially to know

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: himself.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: What pleasure was he given to?

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Rather rejoicing to see another merry, than merry at anything which

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: professed to make him rejoice. A gentleman of all temperance. But leave

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: we him to his events, with a prayer they may prove prosperous, and let

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: me desire to know how you find Claudio prepared. I am made to

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: understand that you have lent him visitation.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He professes to have received no sinister measure from his judge, but

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: most willingly humbles himself to the determination of justice. Yet had

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: he framed to himself, by the instruction of his frailty, many deceiving

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: promises of life, which I, by my good leisure, have discredited to him,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: and now he is resolved to die.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: You have paid the heavens your function, and the prisoner the very debt

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: of your calling. I have laboured for the poor gentleman to the

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: extremest shore of my modesty, but my brother justice have I found so

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: severe that he hath forced me to tell him he is indeed Justice.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: If his own life answer the straitness of his proceeding, it shall

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: become him well; wherein if he chance to fail, he hath sentenced

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: himself.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: I am going to visit the prisoner. Fare you well.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Peace be with you.
[_Exeunt Escalus and Provost._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He who the sword of heaven will bear

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Should be as holy as severe,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Pattern in himself to know,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Grace to stand, and virtue go;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: More nor less to others paying

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Than by self-offences weighing.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Shame to him whose cruel striking

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Kills for faults of his own liking!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Twice treble shame on Angelo,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To weed my vice, and let his grow!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O, what may man within him hide,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Though angel on the outward side!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: How may likeness, made in crimes,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Make practice on the times,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To draw with idle spiders’ strings

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Most ponderous and substantial things!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Craft against vice I must apply.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: With Angelo tonight shall lie

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: His old betrothed but despised.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: So disguise shall, by th’ disguised,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Pay with falsehood false exacting,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And perform an old contracting.
[_Exit._]
Enter Mariana and a Boy singing.

SONG _  Take, O take those lips away, That so sweetly were forsworn, And those eyes, the break of day, Lights that do mislead the morn. But my kisses bring again, Bring again; Seals of love, but sealed in vain, Sealed in vain._
Enter Duke as a Friar.

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Break off thy song, and haste thee quick away;

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Here comes a man of comfort, whose advice

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Hath often stilled my brawling discontent.
[_Exit Boy._]

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: I cry you mercy, sir, and well could wish

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: You had not found me here so musical.

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Let me excuse me, and believe me so,

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: My mirth it much displeased, but pleased my woe.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ’Tis good; though music oft hath such a charm

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To make bad good and good provoke to harm.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I pray you tell me, hath anybody inquired for me here today? Much upon

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: this time have I promised here to meet.

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: You have not been inquired after. I have sat here all day.
Enter Isabella.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I do constantly believe you. The time is come even now. I shall crave

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: your forbearance a little. Maybe I will call upon you anon for some

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: advantage to yourself.

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: I am always bound to you.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Very well met, and welcome.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: What is the news from this good deputy?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: He hath a garden circummured with brick,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Whose western side is with a vineyard backed;

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And to that vineyard is a planched gate

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: That makes his opening with this bigger key.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: This other doth command a little door

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Which from the vineyard to the garden leads;

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: There have I made my promise, upon the

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Heavy middle of the night to call on him.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But shall you on your knowledge find this way?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I have ta’en a due and wary note upon’t;

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: With whispering and most guilty diligence,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: In action all of precept, he did show me

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: The way twice o’er.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Are there no other tokens

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Between you ’greed concerning her observance?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: No, none, but only a repair i’ th’ dark,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: And that I have possessed him my most stay

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Can be but brief, for I have made him know

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I have a servant comes with me along,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: That stays upon me; whose persuasion is

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I come about my brother.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ’Tis well borne up.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I have not yet made known to Mariana

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: A word of this.—What ho, within! Come forth.
Enter Mariana.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I pray you be acquainted with this maid;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: She comes to do you good.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I do desire the like.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Do you persuade yourself that I respect you?

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Good friar, I know you do, and have found it.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Take, then, this your companion by the hand,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Who hath a story ready for your ear.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I shall attend your leisure; but make haste.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The vaporous night approaches.

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Will’t please you walk aside?
[_Exeunt Mariana and Isabella._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O place and greatness, millions of false eyes

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Are stuck upon thee; volumes of report

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Run with these false, and most contrarious quest

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Upon thy doings; thousand escapes of wit

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Make thee the father of their idle dream

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And rack thee in their fancies.
Enter Mariana and Isabella.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Welcome; how agreed?

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: She’ll take the enterprise upon her, father,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: If you advise it.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It is not my consent,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But my entreaty too.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Little have you to say

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: When you depart from him, but, soft and low,

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: “Remember now my brother.”

lines.speaker: MARIANA
lines.text: Fear me not.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Nor, gentle daughter, fear you not at all.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He is your husband on a pre-contract.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To bring you thus together ’tis no sin,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Sith that the justice of your title to him

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Doth flourish the deceit. Come, let us go;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Our corn’s to reap, for yet our tithe’s to sow.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Provost and Pompey.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Come hither, sirrah. Can you cut off a man’s head?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: If the man be a bachelor, sir, I can; but if he be a married man, he’s

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: his wife’s head, and I can never cut off a woman’s head.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Come, sir, leave me your snatches, and yield me a direct answer.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Tomorrow morning are to die Claudio and Barnardine. Here is in our

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: prison a common executioner, who in his office lacks a helper; if you

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: will take it on you to assist him, it shall redeem you from your gyves;

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: if not, you shall have your full time of imprisonment, and your

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: deliverance with an unpitied whipping; for you have been a notorious

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: bawd.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Sir, I have been an unlawful bawd time out of mind, but yet I will be

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: content to be a lawful hangman. I would be glad to receive some

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: instruction from my fellow-partner.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: What ho, Abhorson! Where’s Abhorson, there?
Enter Abhorson.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Do you call, sir?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Sirrah, here’s a fellow will help you tomorrow in your execution. If

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: you think it meet, compound with him by the year, and let him abide

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: here with you; if not, use him for the present, and dismiss him. He

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: cannot plead his estimation with you; he hath been a bawd.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: A bawd, sir? Fie upon him, he will discredit our mystery.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Go to, sir; you weigh equally. A feather will turn the scale.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Pray, sir, by your good favour—for surely, sir, a good favour you have,

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: but that you have a hanging look—do you call, sir, your occupation a

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: mystery?

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Ay, sir, a mystery.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Painting, sir, I have heard say, is a mystery; and your whores, sir,

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: being members of my occupation, using painting, do prove my occupation

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: a mystery. But what mystery there should be in hanging, if I should be

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: hanged, I cannot imagine.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Sir, it is a mystery.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Proof.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Every true man’s apparel fits your thief. If it be too little for your

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: thief, your true man thinks it big enough; if it be too big for your

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: thief, your thief thinks it little enough. So every true man’s apparel

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: fits your thief.
Enter Provost.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Are you agreed?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Sir, I will serve him; for I do find your hangman is a more penitent

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: trade than your bawd. He doth oftener ask forgiveness.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: You, sirrah, provide your block and your axe tomorrow four o’clock.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Come on, bawd. I will instruct thee in my trade. Follow.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: I do desire to learn, sir; and I hope, if you have occasion to use me

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: for your own turn, you shall find me yare. For truly, sir, for your

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: kindness I owe you a good turn.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Call hither Barnardine and Claudio.
[_Exeunt Abhorson and Pompey._]

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Th’ one has my pity; not a jot the other,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Being a murderer, though he were my brother.
Enter Claudio.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Look, here’s the warrant, Claudio, for thy death.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: ’Tis now dead midnight, and by eight tomorrow

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Thou must be made immortal. Where’s Barnardine?

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: As fast locked up in sleep as guiltless labour

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: When it lies starkly in the traveller’s bones.

lines.speaker: CLAUDIO
lines.text: He will not wake.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Who can do good on him?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Well, go, prepare yourself. [_Knocking within_.] But hark, what noise?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Heaven give your spirits comfort!
[_Exit Claudio. Knock within._]

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: By and by!—

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I hope it is some pardon or reprieve

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: For the most gentle Claudio.
Enter Duke.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Welcome, father.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The best and wholesom’st spirits of the night

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Envelop you, good Provost! Who called here of late?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: None, since the curfew rung.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Not Isabel?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: They will then, ere’t be long.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: What comfort is for Claudio?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: There’s some in hope.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: It is a bitter deputy.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Not so, not so. His life is paralleled

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Even with the stroke and line of his great justice.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He doth with holy abstinence subdue

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That in himself which he spurs on his power

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To qualify in others. Were he mealed with that

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Which he corrects, then were he tyrannous;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But this being so, he’s just.
[_Knocking within. Provost goes to the door._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Now are they come.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: This is a gentle provost. Seldom when

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The steeled gaoler is the friend of men.
[_Knocking within_.]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: How now? What noise? That spirit’s possessed with haste

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That wounds th’ unsisting postern with these strokes.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Provost returns.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: There he must stay until the officer

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Arise to let him in. He is called up.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Have you no countermand for Claudio yet,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But he must die tomorrow?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: None, sir, none.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: As near the dawning, Provost, as it is,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You shall hear more ere morning.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Happily

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: You something know, yet I believe there comes

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: No countermand. No such example have we.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Besides, upon the very siege of justice

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Lord Angelo hath to the public ear

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Professed the contrary.
Enter a Messenger.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: This is his Lordship’s man.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And here comes Claudio’s pardon.

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: My lord hath sent you this note, and by me this further charge: that

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: you swerve not from the smallest article of it, neither in time,

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: matter, or other circumstance. Good morrow; for, as I take it, it is

lines.speaker: MESSENGER
lines.text: almost day.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I shall obey him.
[_Exit Messenger._]
[_Aside_.]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: This is his pardon, purchased by such sin

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: For which the pardoner himself is in.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Hence hath offence his quick celerity,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: When it is borne in high authority.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: When vice makes mercy, mercy’s so extended

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That for the fault’s love is th’ offender friended.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Now, sir, what news?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I told you: Lord Angelo, belike thinking me remiss in mine office,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: awakens me with this unwonted putting-on; methinks strangely, for he

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: hath not used it before.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Pray you, let’s hear.
[_Reads_.]

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: _Whatsoever you may hear to the contrary, let Claudio be

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: executed by four of the clock, and in the afternoon, Barnardine. For my

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: better satisfaction, let me have Claudio’s head sent me by five. Let

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: this be duly performed, with a thought that more depends on it than we

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: must yet deliver. Thus fail not to do your office, as you will answer

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: it at your peril._

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: What say you to this, sir?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: What is that Barnardine who is to be executed in th’ afternoon?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: A Bohemian born, but here nursed up and bred; one that is a prisoner

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: nine years old.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: How came it that the absent Duke had not either delivered him to his

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: liberty, or executed him? I have heard it was ever his manner to do so.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: His friends still wrought reprieves for him; and indeed, his fact till

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: now in the government of Lord Angelo, came not to an undoubtful proof.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It is now apparent?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Most manifest, and not denied by himself.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Hath he borne himself penitently in prison? How seems he to be touched?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: A man that apprehends death no more dreadfully but as a drunken sleep;

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: careless, reckless, and fearless of what’s past, present, or to come;

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: insensible of mortality and desperately mortal.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He wants advice.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: He will hear none. He hath evermore had the liberty of the prison; give

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: him leave to escape hence, he would not. Drunk many times a day, if not

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: many days entirely drunk. We have very oft awaked him, as if to carry

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: him to execution, and showed him a seeming warrant for it. It hath not

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: moved him at all.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: More of him anon. There is written in your brow, Provost, honesty and

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: constancy; if I read it not truly, my ancient skill beguiles me. But in

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: the boldness of my cunning I will lay myself in hazard. Claudio, whom

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: here you have warrant to execute, is no greater forfeit to the law than

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Angelo who hath sentenced him. To make you understand this in a

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: manifested effect, I crave but four days’ respite, for the which you

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: are to do me both a present and a dangerous courtesy.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Pray, sir, in what?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: In the delaying death.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Alack, how may I do it? Having the hour limited, and an express

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: command, under penalty, to deliver his head in the view of Angelo? I

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: may make my case as Claudio’s, to cross this in the smallest.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: By the vow of mine order, I warrant you, if my instructions may be your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: guide. Let this Barnardine be this morning executed, and his head borne

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: to Angelo.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Angelo hath seen them both, and will discover the favour.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O, death’s a great disguiser, and you may add to it. Shave the head and

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: tie the beard, and say it was the desire of the penitent to be so bared

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: before his death. You know the course is common. If anything fall to

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: you upon this, more than thanks and good fortune, by the saint whom I

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: profess, I will plead against it with my life.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Pardon me, good father; it is against my oath.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Were you sworn to the Duke, or to the Deputy?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: To him and to his substitutes.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You will think you have made no offence if the Duke avouch the justice

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: of your dealing?

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: But what likelihood is in that?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Not a resemblance, but a certainty. Yet since I see you fearful, that

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: neither my coat, integrity, nor persuasion, can with ease attempt you,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I will go further than I meant, to pluck all fears out of you. Look

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: you, sir, here is the hand and seal of the Duke. You know the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: character, I doubt not, and the signet is not strange to you.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I know them both.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The contents of this is the return of the Duke; you shall anon

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: over-read it at your pleasure, where you shall find within these two

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: days he will be here. This is a thing that Angelo knows not; for he

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: this very day receives letters of strange tenour, perchance of the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Duke’s death, perchance entering into some monastery; but, by chance,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: nothing of what is writ. Look, th’ unfolding star calls up the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: shepherd. Put not yourself into amazement how these things should be.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: All difficulties are but easy when they are known. Call your

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: executioner, and off with Barnardine’s head. I will give him a present

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: shrift, and advise him for a better place. Yet you are amazed; but this

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: shall absolutely resolve you. Come away; it is almost clear dawn.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Pompey.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: I am as well acquainted here as I was in our house of profession. One

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: would think it were Mistress Overdone’s own house, for here be many of

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: her old customers. First, here’s young Master Rash; he’s in for a

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: commodity of brown paper and old ginger, nine score and seventeen

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: pounds; of which he made five marks ready money. Marry, then ginger was

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: not much in request, for the old women were all dead. Then is there

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: here one Master Caper, at the suit of Master Three-pile the mercer, for

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: some four suits of peach-coloured satin, which now peaches him a

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: beggar. Then have we here young Dizie, and young Master Deep-vow, and

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Master Copperspur, and Master Starve-lackey, the rapier and dagger man,

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: and young Drop-heir that killed lusty Pudding, and Master Forthright

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: the tilter, and brave Master Shoe-tie the great traveller, and wild

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Half-can that stabbed Pots, and I think forty more, all great doers in

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: our trade, and are now “for the Lord’s sake.”
Enter Abhorson.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Sirrah, bring Barnardine hither.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Master Barnardine! You must rise and be hanged, Master Barnardine.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: What ho, Barnardine!
[_Within_.]

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: A pox o’ your throats! Who makes that noise there? What are

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: you?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Your friends, sir; the hangman. You must be so good, sir, to rise and

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: be put to death.
[_Within_.]

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: Away, you rogue, away; I am sleepy.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Tell him he must awake, and that quickly too.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Pray, Master Barnardine, awake till you are executed, and sleep

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: afterwards.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Go in to him, and fetch him out.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: He is coming, sir, he is coming. I hear his straw rustle.
Enter Barnardine.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Is the axe upon the block, sirrah?

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: Very ready, sir.

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: How now, Abhorson? What’s the news with you?

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Truly, sir, I would desire you to clap into your prayers; for, look

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: you, the warrant’s come.

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: You rogue, I have been drinking all night; I am not fitted for’t.

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: O, the better, sir; for he that drinks all night and is hanged betimes

lines.speaker: POMPEY
lines.text: in the morning may sleep the sounder all the next day.
Enter Duke.

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: Look you, sir, here comes your ghostly father. Do we jest now, think

lines.speaker: ABHORSON
lines.text: you?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Sir, induced by my charity, and hearing how hastily you are to depart,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I am come to advise you, comfort you, and pray with you.

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: Friar, not I. I have been drinking hard all night, and I will have more

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: time to prepare me, or they shall beat out my brains with billets. I

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: will not consent to die this day, that’s certain.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O, sir, you must; and therefore I beseech you

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Look forward on the journey you shall go.

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: I swear I will not die today for any man’s persuasion.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But hear you—

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: Not a word. If you have anything to say to me, come to my ward, for

lines.speaker: BARNARDINE
lines.text: thence will not I today.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Unfit to live or die. O gravel heart!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: After him, fellows; bring him to the block.
[_Exeunt Abhorson and Pompey._]
Enter Provost.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Now, sir, how do you find the prisoner?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: A creature unprepared, unmeet for death;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And to transport him in the mind he is

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Were damnable.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Here in the prison, father,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: There died this morning of a cruel fever

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: One Ragozine, a most notorious pirate,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: A man of Claudio’s years; his beard and head

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Just of his colour. What if we do omit

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: This reprobate till he were well inclined,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: And satisfy the Deputy with the visage

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Of Ragozine, more like to Claudio?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: O, ’tis an accident that heaven provides!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Dispatch it presently; the hour draws on

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Prefixed by Angelo. See this be done,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And sent according to command, whiles I

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Persuade this rude wretch willingly to die.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: This shall be done, good father, presently.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: But Barnardine must die this afternoon;

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: And how shall we continue Claudio,

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: To save me from the danger that might come

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: If he were known alive?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Let this be done:

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Put them in secret holds, both Barnardine and Claudio.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Ere twice the sun hath made his journal greeting

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To yonder generation, you shall find

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Your safety manifested.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I am your free dependant.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Quick, dispatch, and send the head to Angelo.
[_Exit Provost._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Now will I write letters to Angelo,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The Provost, he shall bear them, whose contents

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Shall witness to him I am near at home;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And that by great injunctions I am bound

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To enter publicly. Him I’ll desire

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To meet me at the consecrated fount,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: A league below the city; and from thence,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: By cold gradation and well-balanced form.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: We shall proceed with Angelo.
Enter Provost.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: Here is the head; I’ll carry it myself.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Convenient is it. Make a swift return;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: For I would commune with you of such things

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: That want no ear but yours.

lines.speaker: PROVOST
lines.text: I’ll make all speed.
[_Exit._]
[_Within_.]

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Peace, ho, be here!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The tongue of Isabel. She’s come to know

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: If yet her brother’s pardon be come hither.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: But I will keep her ignorant of her good,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: To make her heavenly comforts of despair

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: When it is least expected.
Enter Isabella.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Ho, by your leave!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Good morning to you, fair and gracious daughter.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: The better, given me by so holy a man.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Hath yet the Deputy sent my brother’s pardon?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: He hath released him, Isabel, from the world.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: His head is off, and sent to Angelo.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Nay, but it is not so.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: It is no other.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Show your wisdom, daughter, in your close patience.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: O, I will to him and pluck out his eyes!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You shall not be admitted to his sight.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Unhappy Claudio! Wretched Isabel!

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: Injurious world! Most damned Angelo!

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: This nor hurts him nor profits you a jot.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Forbear it, therefore; give your cause to heaven.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Mark what I say, which you shall find

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: By every syllable a faithful verity.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: The Duke comes home tomorrow;—nay, dry your eyes.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: One of our convent, and his confessor,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Gives me this instance. Already he hath carried

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Notice to Escalus and Angelo,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Who do prepare to meet him at the gates,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: There to give up their power. If you can, pace your wisdom

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: In that good path that I would wish it go,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And you shall have your bosom on this wretch,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Grace of the Duke, revenges to your heart,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And general honour.

lines.speaker: ISABELLA
lines.text: I am directed by you.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: This letter, then, to Friar Peter give;

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: ’Tis that he sent me of the Duke’s return.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Say, by this token, I desire his company

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: At Mariana’s house tonight. Her cause and yours

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I’ll perfect him withal, and he shall bring you

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Before the Duke; and to the head of Angelo

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Accuse him home and home. For my poor self,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: I am combined by a sacred vow,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: And shall be absent. Wend you with this letter.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Command these fretting waters from your eyes

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: With a light heart; trust not my holy order,

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: If I pervert your course.—Who’s here?
Enter Lucio.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Good even. Friar, where is the Provost?

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Not within, sir.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: O pretty Isabella, I am pale at mine heart to see thine eyes so red.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Thou must be patient. I am fain to dine and sup with water and bran. I

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: dare not for my head fill my belly. One fruitful meal would set me

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: to’t. But they say the Duke will be here tomorrow. By my troth, Isabel,

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: I loved thy brother. If the old fantastical duke of dark corners had

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: been at home, he had lived.
[_Exit Isabella._]

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Sir, the Duke is marvellous little beholding to your reports; but the

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: best is, he lives not in them.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Friar, thou knowest not the Duke so well as I do. He’s a better woodman

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: than thou tak’st him for.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Well, you’ll answer this one day. Fare ye well.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Nay, tarry, I’ll go along with thee. I can tell thee pretty tales of

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: the Duke.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: You have told me too many of him already, sir, if they be true; if not

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: true, none were enough.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: I was once before him for getting a wench with child.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Did you such a thing?

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: Yes, marry, did I; but I was fain to forswear it. They would else have

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: married me to the rotten medlar.

lines.speaker: DUKE
lines.text: Sir, your company is fairer than honest. Rest you well.

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: By my troth, I’ll go with thee to the lane’s end. If bawdy talk offend

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: you, we’ll have very little of it. Nay, friar, I am a kind of burr; I

lines.speaker: LUCIO
lines.text: shall stick.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Angelo and Escalus.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: Every letter he hath writ hath disvouched other.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: In most uneven and distracted manner. His actions show much like to

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: madness; pray heaven his wisdom be not tainted. And why meet him at the

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: gates and redeliver our authorities there?

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: I guess not.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: And why should we proclaim it in an hour before his entering, that if

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: any crave redress of injustice, they should exhibit their petitions in

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: the street?

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: He shows his reason for that: to have a dispatch of complaints, and to

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: deliver us from devices hereafter, which shall then have no power to

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: stand against us.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Well, I beseech you, let it be proclaimed.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Betimes i’ th’ morn I’ll call you at your house.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Give notice to such men of sort and suit

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: As are to meet him.

lines.speaker: ESCALUS
lines.text: I shall, sir. Fare you well.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Good night.

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: This deed unshapes me quite, makes me unpregnant

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: And dull to all proceedings. A deflowered maid;

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: And by an eminent body that enforced

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: The law against it! But that her tender shame

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Will not proclaim against her maiden loss,

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: How might she tongue me! Yet reason dares her no,

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: For my authority bears so credent bulk

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: That no particular scandal once can touch

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: But it confounds the breather. He should have lived,

lines.speaker: ANGELO
lines.text: Save that his riotous youth, with dangerous sense,
